name: Pro page: licence ended
what: An ended licence says when it ended, with Renew and Enter key (was the plain buy page).

name: Pro page: removed by another device
what: "Pixel 9 removed this device from your license." with Pair again and Enter key.

name: Licence key refused: can retry
what: A key that could not be checked says why, with Try again and Contact support.

name: Licence key refused: ended
what: An ended key says "This license has expired." with Renew.
